    Changelog

    2.0.0 - 2026-08-11

    Added

    • Added the explicit module extension API based on IToolbarModule, ILegacyToolbarModule, and ToolbarModuleRegistry.
    • Added Project Settings > NKStudio > Custom Toolbar.
    • Added settings for module visibility, scene search folders, and time scale range and reset values.
    • Added a time scale slider for Unity 2022.3 through Unity 6.2.
    • Added Edit Mode tests for module registration and settings validation.
    • Added compile verification for Unity 2022.3, 6000.0, 6000.3, and 6000.5.
    • Added the extend-custom-toolbar AI skill, which selects the correct module API for the project's Unity version.

    Changed

    • Moved Unity 6.3 and newer to the official MainToolbar.Refresh lifecycle.
    • Limited reflection on Unity 2022.3 through Unity 6.2 to a single legacy host.
    • Separated FMOD and Localization into optional assemblies.
    • Replaced one-second scene polling with Build Settings and configuration change events.
    • Moved all code into the NKStudio.CustomToolbar namespace.
    • Disabled FMOD Debug, Enter Play Mode, and Scene Switcher consistently during Play Mode.

    Fixed

    • Prevented duplicate UI and Editor event registration after repeated toolbar reconstruction.
    • Corrected the first-scene button when Build Settings contains no enabled scenes.
    • Corrected duplicate scene names and multiple search-folder handling.
    • Restored the legacy toolbar after Domain Reload configuration and toolbar layout changes.

    Removed

    • Removed ToolbarExtensionRegistry.LeftToolbarGUI.
    • Removed ToolbarEventHandler.
    • Removed per-feature anonymous playModeStateChanged subscriptions.
    • Removed MainToolbarWindow reflection and generated UI-name lookup on Unity 6.3 and newer.

    Migration

    • Convert existing ToolbarExtensionRegistry.LeftToolbarGUI extensions to an IToolbarModule implementation registered with ToolbarModuleRegistry.Register().
    • Move hard-coded scene search paths to Scene Search Folders in Project Settings.

    1.0.0

    Added

    • Added the Enter Play Mode Options toggle.
    • Added the first Build Settings scene button and scene selection menu.
    • Added the FMOD Debug Overlay toggle.
    • Added the Localization Locale menu.
    • Added the time scale slider for Unity 6.
    • Added Unity 2022 and Unity 6 toolbar support.
